_comment: Single source of truth for role access. Read by backend/core/policy.py and frontend/src/policy/policy.ts. Anything not listed is denied.

actions.auth.login: Sign in with a role tab
actions.auth.otp_verify: Check the emailed 6-digit code and start the customer session
actions.auth.session: Read the current session (or none) and renew it from the refresh cookie
actions.auth.password_reset: Request a customer password reset email
actions.auth.password_reset_confirm: Set a new password from a reset link
actions.auth.invite_check: Read a staff invite from its link
actions.auth.invite_accept: Set a password from a staff invite link
actions.dev.mailbox: Read the simulated email outbox (development only)
actions.staff.invites.resend: Resend a staff invite with a new link
actions.public.site: Read website content (home page and footer)
actions.public.page: Read a policy page (privacy, terms, cancellation)
actions.booking.options: Read booking sheet options for a service
actions.booking.slots: List free start times and the price for a service choice
actions.my.appointments.list: List my own booking requests and appointments
actions.my.appointments.read: Read one of my own appointments
actions.my.appointments.update: Cancel, flag (I'm here, reschedule, cancel request) or resend the payment link for my own appointment
actions.my.payment.read: Read the payment due for my own appointment
actions.my.payment.pay: Pay for my own appointment (mock gateway)
actions.my.invoices.read: Read one of my own invoices
actions.my.ratings.list: List my visits that are waiting for a rating
actions.my.ratings.submit: Rate my stylist for one of my own paid visits (once)
actions.desk.appointments.list: List all booking requests and appointments
actions.desk.appointments.read: Read one appointment with confirm options
actions.desk.appointments.confirm: Confirm a request (stylist, time, room) and send a payment link
actions.desk.appointments.reject: Reject a request with a reason
actions.desk.appointments.move: Move a held or scheduled booking to another stylist, room or time
actions.desk.appointments.cancel: Cancel a held, scheduled or checked-in booking (reason required)
actions.desk.appointments.no_show: Mark a scheduled booking as a no-show after its start time
actions.desk.appointments.dismiss: Decline a customer's reschedule or cancel request
actions.desk.schedule.read: Read one day of the schedule by stylist and room
actions.desk.appointments.check_in: Check a scheduled guest in on the day of the visit
actions.desk.bookings.create: Book a walk-in or phone customer and list free times for it
actions.desk.customers.list: Search customers by name, email or full mobile number
actions.desk.customers.create: Register a customer at the desk
actions.desk.customers.read: Read a customer with visit history and front-desk notes
actions.desk.customers.update: Edit a customer's name, phone, allergies or preferences
actions.desk.customers.notes: Add a front-desk note to a customer
actions.pos.read: Read the POS queue, a visit's checkout screen and a bill preview
actions.pos.checkout: Bill a visit: products, discount within the cap, loyalty points, tip, payments
actions.pos.refunds.request: Ask for a refund on an invoice (the admin refunds directly)
actions.pos.refunds.list: List refunds waiting for a decision
actions.cash.close.read: Read the day's takings and cash-close record
actions.cash.close.sign: Sign off the daily cash close
actions.work.ping: Tell the server the receptionist is active (keeps the session from idling out)
actions.hours.read: Read my own work sessions, hours and estimated pay
actions.staff.hours.read: Read a receptionist's work sessions, hours and estimated pay
actions.staff.hours.correct: Correct a receptionist's work session times (reason required)
actions.stylist.appointments.list: List my own visits (today, upcoming, past)
actions.stylist.appointments.read: Read one of my own visits: first name, services, allergy and preference notes, history with me
actions.stylist.appointments.start: Start the service on my own checked-in visit
actions.stylist.appointments.complete: Complete my own in-progress visit with the services really done and a note
actions.stylist.ratings.read: Read my own ratings and comments (no customer names)
actions.stylist.earnings.read: Read my own estimated pay for a month
actions.stylist.schedule.read: Read my working hours and days-off requests
actions.stylist.daysoff.withdraw: Withdraw a days-off request that is still waiting
actions.chat.threads.list: List my Zen Chat conversations (person cards with unread counts)
actions.chat.messages.list: Read the messages of one of my conversations
actions.chat.messages.send: Send a message in one of my conversations (REST fallback)
actions.chat.messages.read: Mark one of my conversations as read
actions.chat.ws.connect: Open the live Zen Chat connection for one of my conversations
actions.chat.ws.send: Send messages, typing and read signals over the live connection
